records.rule: SSH can invoke owning MU operator actions, but the actual MI work and result must traverse authenticated XTP / Queue Fabric.
Require authenticated result plus RTO2 committed state and controller durable receipt; a packet ACK is insufficient.
Require authoritative service descriptor, route-peer and operational class; receiver-channel labels cannot substitute.
Append identities and preserve existing commissioning keys; H-local test keys do not grant federation membership.
Inspect the live QEMU initramfs, not a staged directory, and retain boot/runtime fixes.
Mark fixture-only PASS for sorter code; never label ten-host run accepted without twenty real distinct receipts.
